AI from zero - code notebooks
=============================

One Jupyter notebook per lesson. Run the cells in order, from the top.

Open them with:
  - VS Code (with the Python and Jupyter extensions), on your computer
  - Google Colab: colab.research.google.com -> File -> Upload notebook
  - Kaggle: kaggle.com -> Code -> New Notebook -> File -> Import Notebook

Setup (lesson 2):
  python -m venv .venv
  .venv\Scripts\activate          (Windows)
  pip install numpy pandas matplotlib scikit-learn jupyter

PyTorch (lesson 38 onwards): use the command from pytorch.org/get-started/locally
for your system and CUDA version.

Numbers you get may differ a little from the lesson (other library version, GPU vs CPU).

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l23-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "import numpy as np\n", "\n", "def kmeans(X, init_centers, max_iter=100):\n", " C = np.array(init_centers, dtype=float)\n", " labels = None\n", " for it in range(max_iter):\n", " d = ((X[:, None, :] - C[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2) # مسافة كل نقطة إلى كل مركز\n", " new_labels = d.argmin(axis=1) # الإسناد\n", " if labels is not None and np.array_equal(new_labels, labels):\n", " break\n", " labels = new_labels\n", " C = np.array([X[labels == k].mean(axis=0) for k in range(len(C))]) # التحديث\n", " inertia = ((X - C[labels]) ** 2).sum()\n", " return C, labels, inertia, it\n", "\n", "P = np.array([[1, 1], [1, 2], [2, 1], [6, 5], [7, 6], [6, 6]])\n", "C, labels, inertia, it = kmeans(P, init_centers=[[1, 1], [1, 2]])\n", "print(\"centers:\\n\", C.round(3))\n", "print(\"labels:\", labels, \" inertia:\", round(inertia, 3), \" stopped at round\", it)" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l23-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l36-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "import numpy as np\n", "\n", "x, y = 2.0, 1.0\n", "w, b = np.array([0.5, -1.0]), np.array([0.0, 1.0])\n", "v, c = np.array([1.0, 2.0]), 0.5\n", "\n", "def forward(w, b, v, c):\n", " z = w * x + b\n", " h = np.maximum(0, z)\n", " y_hat = v @ h + c\n", " return z, h, y_hat, (y_hat - y) ** 2\n", "\n", "z, h, y_hat, loss = forward(w, b, v, c)\n", "print(\"forward : z =\", z, \" h =\", h, \" y_hat =\", y_hat, \" loss =\", loss)\n", "\n", "# backward, from the loss to the inputs\n", "g_yhat = 2 * (y_hat - y)\n", "g_v, g_c = g_yhat * h, g_yhat\n", "g_h = g_yhat * v\n", "g_z = g_h * (z > 0) # ReLU: pass the gradient only where z > 0\n", "g_w, g_b = g_z * x, g_z\n", "print(\"grads : w\", g_w, \" b\", g_b, \" v\", g_v, \" c\", g_c)\n", "\n", "lr = 0.1\n", "w, b, v, c = w - lr * g_w, b - lr * g_b, v - lr * g_v, c - lr * g_c\n", "print(\"new loss:\", round(forward(w, b, v, c)[3], 4))" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l36-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l41-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "import numpy as np\n", "import torch\n", "import torch.nn.functional as F\n", "from torch import nn\n", "\n", "def conv2d(image, kernel):\n", " \"\"\"Slide the kernel over the image: multiply element-wise and sum (no padding, stride 1).\"\"\"\n", " k = kernel.shape[0]\n", " n = image.shape[0] - k + 1\n", " out = np.zeros((n, n))\n", " for i in range(n):\n", " for j in range(n):\n", " out[i, j] = np.sum(image[i:i + k, j:j + k] * kernel)\n", " return out\n", "\n", "image = np.array([[0, 0, 9, 9, 9]] * 5, dtype=float)\n", "vertical_edge = np.array([[-1, 0, 1]] * 3, dtype=float)\n", "print(conv2d(image, vertical_edge))\n", "\n", "# same computation in PyTorch; shapes: (batch, channels, height, width)\n", "t = F.conv2d(torch.tensor(image)[None, None], torch.tensor(vertical_edge)[None, None])\n", "print(t[0, 0])" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l41-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l41-011", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "def shift(X, dx=0, dy=0):\n", " \"\"\"Move images dx pixels right and dy pixels down, filling the gap with zeros.\"\"\"\n", " out = torch.roll(X, shifts=(dy, dx), dims=(2, 3))\n", " if dx > 0: out[..., :, :dx] = 0\n", " if dx < 0: out[..., :, dx:] = 0\n", " if dy > 0: out[..., :dy, :] = 0\n", " if dy < 0: out[..., dy:, :] = 0\n", " return out\n", "\n", "def train(model, epochs=30, augment=False):\n", " opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=3e-3)\n", " loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n", " g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)\n", " for _ in range(epochs):\n", " model.train()\n", " for idx in torch.randperm(len(X_tr), generator=g).split(32):\n", " xb = X_tr[idx]\n", " if augment: # random shift of -1, 0 or +1 pixel\n", " dx, dy = torch.randint(-1, 2, (2,), generator=g).tolist()\n", " xb = shift(xb, dx, dy)\n", " loss = loss_fn(model(xb), y_tr[idx])\n", " opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step()\n", " return model\n", "\n", "def accuracy(model, X):\n", " model.eval()\n", " with torch.no_grad():\n", " return (model(X).argmax(1) == y_te).float().mean().item()\n", "\n", "for name, make in [(\"MLP\", make_mlp), (\"CNN\", make_cnn)]:\n", " model = train(make())\n", " print(f\"{name}: test {accuracy(model, X_te):.3f} | shifted 1px {accuracy(model, shift(X_te, 1)):.3f}\"\n", " f\" | shifted 2px {accuracy(model, shift(X_te, 2)):.3f}\")" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l41-012", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l42-006", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "def make_batch(n, T, g):\n", " first = torch.randint(0, 2, (n,), generator=g) # the bit to remember\n", " x = torch.randn(n, T, 1, generator=g) * 0.2 # small noise everywhere\n", " x[:, 0, 0] = first.float() * 2 - 1 # +1 or -1 at the first step\n", " return x, first\n", "\n", "class Reader(nn.Module):\n", " def __init__(self, kind, hidden=32):\n", " super().__init__()\n", " self.rnn = (nn.RNN if kind == \"RNN\" else nn.LSTM)(1, hidden, batch_first=True)\n", " if kind == \"LSTM\": # start with the forget gate open: remember by default\n", " with torch.no_grad():\n", " for name, p in self.rnn.named_parameters():\n", " if \"bias\" in name:\n", " p[hidden:2 * hidden].fill_(1.5) # two bias vectors: 1.5 + 1.5 = 3\n", " self.head = nn.Linear(hidden, 2)\n", "\n", " def forward(self, x):\n", " outputs, _ = self.rnn(x)\n", " return self.head(outputs[:, -1]) # decide from the last hidden state\n", "\n", "def run(kind, T, steps=500, seed=0):\n", " torch.manual_seed(seed)\n", " g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)\n", " net = Reader(kind)\n", " opt = torch.optim.Adam(net.parameters(), lr=3e-3)\n", " loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n", " for _ in range(steps):\n", " x, y = make_batch(64, T, g)\n", " loss = loss_fn(net(x), y)\n", " opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward()\n", " nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(net.parameters(), max_norm=1.0) # against exploding gradients\n", " opt.step()\n", " x, y = make_batch(1000, T, torch.Generator().manual_seed(123))\n", " with torch.no_grad():\n", " return (net(x).argmax(1) == y).float().mean().item()\n", "\n", "for T in [10, 30, 60]:\n", " print(f\"T = {T:3}: RNN accuracy {run('RNN', T):.3f} | LSTM accuracy {run('LSTM', T):.3f}\")" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l42-007", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l43-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "from collections import Counter\n", "\n", "def train_bpe(word_counts, n_merges):\n", " \"\"\"word_counts: {word: count}. Returns the merge rules and the final segmentation.\"\"\"\n", " words = {w: list(w) for w in word_counts} # start from characters\n", " merges = []\n", " for _ in range(n_merges):\n", " pairs = Counter()\n", " for w, toks in words.items():\n", " for a, b in zip(toks, toks[1:]):\n", " pairs[(a, b)] += word_counts[w] # weighted by word frequency\n", " if not pairs:\n", " break\n", " best = max(pairs, key=pairs.get) # ties: the first pair seen wins\n", " merges.append(best)\n", " for w in words:\n", " words[w] = apply_merge(words[w], best)\n", " return merges, words\n", "\n", "def apply_merge(toks, pair):\n", " out, i = [], 0\n", " while i < len(toks):\n", " if i + 1 < len(toks) and (toks[i], toks[i + 1]) == pair:\n", " out.append(toks[i] + toks[i + 1])\n", " i += 2\n", " else:\n", " out.append(toks[i])\n", " i += 1\n", " return out\n", "\n", "def encode_word(word, merges):\n", " toks = list(word)\n", " for pair in merges: # same order as training\n", " toks = apply_merge(toks, pair)\n", " return toks\n", "\n", "corpus = {\"كتب\": 8, \"كتاب\": 4, \"مكتب\": 6, \"مكتبة\": 2, \"يكتب\": 5}\n", "merges, words = train_bpe(corpus, 3)\n", "print(\"merges:\", merges)\n", "print(\"words :\", words)\n", "for w in [\"يكتبون\", \"مكتوب\", \"كاتب\", \"فكتب\"]:\n", " print(w, \"->\", encode_word(w, merges))" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l43-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l45-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "import math\n", "from collections import Counter, defaultdict\n", "\n", "sentences = [\"أنا أحب القهوة\", \"أنا أحب الشاي\", \"أنت تحب القهوة\"]\n", "counts = defaultdict(Counter)\n", "for s in sentences:\n", " words = [\"\"] + s.split() + [\"\"]\n", " for prev, nxt in zip(words, words[1:]):\n", " counts[prev][nxt] += 1\n", "\n", "def prob(prev, nxt):\n", " return counts[prev][nxt] / sum(counts[prev].values())\n", "\n", "def sentence_prob(s):\n", " words = [\"\"] + s.split() + [\"\"]\n", " steps = [prob(a, b) for a, b in zip(words, words[1:])]\n", " return math.prod(steps), steps\n", "\n", "p, steps = sentence_prob(\"أنا أحب القهوة\")\n", "loss = -sum(math.log(q) for q in steps) / len(steps)\n", "print(\"P =\", round(p, 4), \" steps:\", [round(q, 3) for q in steps])\n", "print(\"loss =\", round(loss, 3), \" perplexity =\", round(math.exp(loss), 2))\n", "print(\"P(أنت تحب الشاي) =\", sentence_prob(\"أنت تحب الشاي\")[0])" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l45-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l46-002", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "import numpy as np\n", "import torch\n", "import torch.nn.functional as F\n", "from torch import nn\n", "\n", "def softmax(x):\n", " e = np.exp(x - x.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))\n", " return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)\n", "\n", "def attention(Q, K, V, causal=False):\n", " scores = Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(K.shape[-1]) # (n, n)\n", " if causal:\n", " future = np.triu(np.ones_like(scores, dtype=bool), k=1)\n", " scores = np.where(future, -np.inf, scores) # hide the future\n", " weights = softmax(scores) # each row sums to 1\n", " return weights @ V, weights\n", "\n", "Q = np.array([[1, 0, 1, 0], [0, 2, 0, 2], [2, 0, 2, 0]], dtype=float)\n", "K = np.array([[1, 0, 1, 0], [0, 1, 0, 1], [1, 1, 0, 0]], dtype=float)\n", "V = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]], dtype=float)\n", "\n", "out, w = attention(Q, K, V)\n", "print(\"weights:\\n\", w.round(3), \"\\noutput:\\n\", out.round(3))\n", "out_c, w_c = attention(Q, K, V, causal=True)\n", "print(\"causal weights:\\n\", w_c.round(3), \"\\ncausal output:\\n\", out_c.round(3))" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l46-003", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "

\n", "\n", "### طبقة انتباه كاملة\n", "\n", "
" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "execution_count": null, "id": "l46-006", "metadata": {}, "outputs": [], "source": [ "class SelfAttention(nn.Module):\n", " def __init__(self, d_model, d_k):\n", " super().__init__()\n", " self.W_q = nn.Linear(d_model, d_k, bias=False)\n", " self.W_k = nn.Linear(d_model, d_k, bias=False)\n", " self.W_v = nn.Linear(d_model, d_k, bias=False)\n", "\n", " def forward(self, x): # x: (batch, n, d_model)\n", " q, k, v = self.W_q(x), self.W_k(x), self.W_v(x) # (batch, n, d_k)\n", " scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) / k.shape[-1] ** 0.5 # (batch, n, n)\n", " n = x.shape[1]\n", " future = torch.triu(torch.ones(n, n, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)\n", " scores = scores.masked_fill(future, float(\"-inf\"))\n", " weights = scores.softmax(dim=-1)\n", " return weights @ v, weights\n", "\n", "torch.manual_seed(0)\n", "layer = SelfAttention(d_model=8, d_k=8)\n", "x = torch.randn(2, 5, 8) # 2 sentences, 5 tokens, 8 numbers each\n", "y, weights = layer(x)\n", "print(\"output:\", tuple(y.shape), \" weights:\", tuple(weights.shape))\n", "print(\"first sentence weights:\\n\", weights[0].detach().numpy().round(2))\n", "print(\"parameters:\", sum(p.numel() for p in layer.parameters()))" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "id": "l46-007", "metadata": {}, "source": [ "
